pricing.heading: Simple, credit-based pricing
pricing.sub: Start free. Upgrade when you need more credits, models and resolution.
pricing.basicDesc: For getting a project off the ground.
pricing.proDesc: For heavy output and client work.
pricing.ultimateDesc: For studios and teams at full tilt.
pricing.subscribedElsewhere: You subscribed in the {platform} app. Manage or change your plan there.
pricing.faqCreditsA: One credit is the unit we bill generations in, and it is worth 10 cents on every plan. Most images cost 1 to 4 credits; a 5-second video costs between 4 and 43, depending on the model and resolution. You always see the cost before you generate.
pricing.faqResetA: Plan credits reset at the start of each 30-day period — unspent plan credits do not roll over. Credits you were given for free never expire. Credits you buy in a top-up pack last 6 months, and that clock pauses whenever you have no active plan, so you never lose time you couldn't use. Top-ups can only be spent while a plan is active.
pricing.faqCancelA: Yes. You keep your plan and its credits until the end of the period you have already paid for.
pricing.faqMobileQ: Why does the app cost more?
pricing.faqMobileA: Apple and Google take a share of every purchase made inside an app. Subscribing here on the web avoids that, which is why the same plan costs less.
pricing.checkoutFailed: Could not start checkout. Please try again.
pricing.successBody: Your plan is active and your credits have been added.
pricing.successPendingBody: This usually takes a couple of seconds.
pricing.pageSub: Every plan unlocks every model. The only thing that changes is how much you make.
pricing.metaDescription: Plans from $19/month. Every model included on every plan. See exactly how many images and videos your credits buy.
pricing.tableSub: Real numbers, straight from the same prices we charge. No model is locked to a higher plan.
pricing.tableFootnote: Counts assume each model's default quality and clip length, shown under its name. Higher resolutions and longer clips cost more, so your actual mix will vary. Credits refresh every 30 days on every plan, yearly included.
pricing.topupSub: Top up any time without changing your plan.
pricing.topupNeedsPlan: Credit packs are available on any paid plan. Subscribe first.
pricing.topupFootnote: One-time purchase, not a subscription. Credits are added instantly and are non-refundable. They last 6 months, and the clock pauses if your plan lapses — so you never lose time you couldn't spend. Top-up credits are used after your monthly plan credits.
pricing.faqRefundA: A plan can be refunded within 7 days, as long as none of that period's credits have been used — once a generation runs we've already paid the model provider for it. Credit top-ups are non-refundable, because the credits are delivered and spendable the moment you buy them.

about.metaDescription: Clickefy is one studio for AI images and video: Gemini, GPT Image, Kling, Seedance and Seedream in one workspace, priced in one honest credit balance.
about.pageHeading: One studio. Every model that matters.
about.pageSub: Clickefy puts the leading AI image and video models in a single workspace. Write a prompt, drop in your references, pick the model for the job, and your results land in projects you can search, favorite, reuse and share — with the price shown before you spend a credit.
about.modelsHeading: Built on the frontier, not on one vendor
about.modelsSub: We integrate the strongest models from Google, OpenAI, Kuaishou and ByteDance directly, and add new ones as they ship — you never wait for us to catch up, and you never pay for five subscriptions.
about.howHeading: From idea to finished asset in three steps
about.step1Body: Type what you want in the prompt bar, in English or Arabic. Attach references, a start frame, a clip to edit or a voice to match — the composer adapts its controls to whatever model you pick.
about.step2Title: Pick the model, see the price
about.step2Body: Switch between image and video models with one click. Quality, duration, aspect ratio and sound are all on the bar, and the credit cost updates live so there are never surprises on the bill.
about.step3Body: Every generation files into a project. Folders, favorites, a media library for your uploads, one-click re-use of any past setup, and download in original quality.
about.imagesBody: Generate and edit with GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro and Nano Banana 2, and the Seedream line — up to 4K, with multi-image references and strong text rendering.
about.videoBody: Kling 2.6, Kling 3, Kling 3 Omni and Kling O1 alongside Seedance 2.0 and 2.5. Text-to-video, image-to-video with start and end frames, multi-reference clips, native audio, and editing or extending footage you already have.
about.toolsBody: Camera Angle re-shoots a photo from a new position. Storyboard turns a script into a sheet of frames. Templates give you a tuned pipeline for common shots. All built on the models, so you don't have to prompt-engineer.
about.creditsBody: Every model is priced in the same credits, shown before you generate. Failed jobs refund automatically. Plan credits renew monthly, top-ups last a year, and free credits never expire.
about.cameraBody: Drag the camera around your photo and get the same subject, same light, same styling from the new position. Exact degrees, matched aspect ratio, no reshoot.
about.storyboardBody: Paste a script or an idea, pick a style, choose how many shots — and get one clean, high-resolution storyboard sheet ready for the pitch or the shoot.
about.principlesHeading: Three things we won't compromise on
about.honestPricingBody: The number on the button is the number you're charged, computed by the same code the server bills with. No hidden multipliers, no per-model subscriptions.
about.yourWorkBody: Your uploads and results live in your projects and your media library. Download them in original quality any time, and delete your account and data whenever you choose.
about.safetyBody: Clear content rules, a report button on every result, and provider safety filters on every request. We're transparent about which AI partners process your inputs and why.
about.companyBody: Clickefy is built and operated by Cast U FZE LLC. We are a small team of creators and engineers who got tired of paying for five tools to finish one campaign.
about.ctaSub: Start free — your first generations are on us, and every model is unlocked from day one.

contact.metaDescription: Reach the Clickefy team for support, billing, bug reports, partnerships, press and trust & safety. One inbox, read by humans.
contact.pageHeading: Talk to a person, not a bot.
contact.pageSub: Questions, feedback, a bug, a billing issue, a partnership idea — write to us and a member of the team will read it. Pick a topic below so it reaches the right person faster.
contact.topicsSub: Each button opens an email with the subject filled in. Same inbox, faster routing.
contact.supportBody: Something unclear, a generation that didn't turn out, a feature you can't find. Tell us what you were trying to do.
contact.billingBody: Plans, top-ups, invoices, refunds, a balance that looks wrong. Include the email on your account so we can look it up.
contact.bugBody: Something broke. The page you were on, what you clicked, what you expected and what happened instead — screenshots welcome.
contact.partnershipsBody: Agencies, studios, creator programs, integrations. Tell us who you are and what you have in mind.
contact.pressBody: Interviews, quotes, brand assets. We answer press inquiries first.
contact.trustBody: Content that breaks our rules, a copyright concern, a privacy request. Reports are read by a human and handled confidentially.
contact.tipsHeading: What helps us help you faster
contact.tip1: The email address on your Clickefy account, so we can find your history.
contact.tip2: For a failed or odd generation, the project name and roughly when it ran — we can trace the job from there.
contact.tip3: For bugs, your browser or app version and a screenshot. One picture saves three emails.
